name: Asagiri (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Asagiri town emblem in green and blue: a green and blue stylised letter U of two curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Asagiri, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 2003.

features.role: Asagiri town emblem — a green and blue stylised letter U of two curved strokes
